name: io.github.entropyvortex/ai-consensus-mcp
description: MCP server exposing the Consensus Validation Protocol — multi-model debate with confidence-weighted scoring, disagreement detection, and an optional judge synthesizer. Generic `consensus` tool plus 13 task-tuned expert panels (architecture, code review, security red-team, ML research, decision support, incident postmortem, product strategy, research synthesis), an opt-in persistent project-memory layer, and a benchmarking CLI. Available over stdio (local hosts) and stateless Streamable HTTP (remote/Grok custom connectors).

runtimeArguments.name: subcommand
runtimeArguments.description: Run the MCP server (vs. the `install` subcommand).

runtimeArguments.name: --config
runtimeArguments.description: Absolute path to your consensus.config.json (providers, participants, optional judge).

environmentVariables.name: GROK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: xAI API key. Required if your config declares an `xai` provider.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key. Required if your config declares an `anthropic` provider.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key. Required if your config declares an `openai` provider.

environmentVariables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Groq API key. Required if your config declares a `groq` provider.

environmentVariables.name: CONSENSUS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Fallback config path if --config is omitted.

runtimeArguments.name: --http
runtimeArguments.description: Serve over stateless Streamable HTTP (remote MCP clients, Grok custom connectors).

runtimeArguments.name: --host
runtimeArguments.description: Bind address (default 127.0.0.1; use 0.0.0.0 behind a reverse proxy).

runtimeArguments.name: --path
runtimeArguments.description: MCP endpoint path (default /mcp). Register this full URL with Grok.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: xAI API key. Required if your config declares an `xai` provider.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key. Required if your config declares an `anthropic` provider.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key. Required if your config declares an `openai` provider.

environmentVariables.name: CONSENSUS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Fallback config path if --config is omitted.

environmentVariables.name: CONSENSUS_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to enable HTTP mode (equivalent to --http).

environmentVariables.name: CONSENSUS_HTTP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret required on public HTTP deploys. Clients send Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-Consensus-Api-Key.
